rotation_order.outer_pins: Follow upright yaw and translation; source proper side orientation retained.
rotation_order.retainers: Follow their upper/lower arms, not steering yaw.
rotation_order.wheel_adapter_and_wheel: Follow upright yaw/translation; spin about resulting wheel axle. Do not scale source wheel.

rotation_order.tie: Align its nominal centerline to the current inner→outer vector and translate to current inner eye. Tubes are axisymmetric; joint pin axes remain defined separately.
rotation_order.tie_inner_pin: Translate with rack; fixed inclined pin axis.
rotation_order.tie_outer_pin: Rotate with upright; inclined axis yawed by steer.
